Parity: unverified until this tier passes its eval set — ✓ appears only after it does.
INT4 KV cache + sliding-window eviction, so long conversations don't grow unbounded.
Prefill runs where compute is fastest, decode where bandwidth is. Using both raises usable bandwidth ~43 → 59 GB/s.
Small fine-tunes for each job — this is what makes a phone-sized model punch above its weight. Loaded over the base model, a few MB each.
Each cloud answer is a worked example. Collected, they train the small adapters that bring on-device quality up to cloud level — and a slice is held back to prove it. Stored on this device only.
